sourceSteps: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向大腿。
保持双臂伸直，呼气并将哑铃举至身前，直至与肩齐平。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
equipmentInterpretation: The canonical equipment label is weighted; its own four source steps explicitly specify one dumbbell in each hand. This asset follows those steps, without mapping another exercise ID.
startPose: Side-profile upright standing, soft knees, both overhand-held dumbbells at thighs, elbows nearly straight.
endPose: Both long nearly straight arms extend forward to shoulder height, elbow angle unchanged, paws and dumbbells remain a full arm-length ahead of torso.
support: Both feet remain planted, torso and head upright and still.
criticalChecks: Shoulder rotation drives the arc; no elbow curl or preceding curl-then-extension.
The two distinct dumbbells maintain paw contact and shape.
Feet, torso, head, framing and camera remain fixed.
plannedProcessing: If the complete four-second upward phase passes actual frame review, concatenate the complete accepted forward phase and its reverse to illustrate one controlled raise and lowering. Record this explicitly; not an unedited eight-second generated repetition. This processing is unsuitable for directional walking, rope rotation or ballistic landings.
